title: 第26章 圆满第27章 切磋
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: “三瓶沸血丹。”
吴青崖赠予的气血药中，只有三瓶沸血丹，确切地说，是只有三瓶丹药，而剩下的，则都是各种珍稀宝药。
每一种宝药上都绑着详细介绍了名称与功效的布条。
例如这可强健筋骨的铁骨参，还有可锤炼气血的血玉芝等等，这每一种放在外城区，都足以令一众石堡争得头破血流的气血宝药，此处却有好几种！
大概是觉得赠予沸血丹太过“低端”，亦或是是镇妖司的这些气血宝药一直没什么人用，所以吴青崖一次性给了不少。
“若是修行资源也能这么慷慨的给我那该多好。”
沈长青都被这吴青崖的手笔给惊呆了，他咽了口唾沫，没有丝毫浪费时间，直接进入了忘我的修炼之中。
时间流逝。
不知多少天后。
小院房间内。
某一刻，沈长青睁开了双眼。
只见他全身肌肤散发着淡淡的金性光泽，似以无数金色琉璃丝织造而成，全身骨骼密度剧增，既内蕴白玉温润光泽，又外显玄铁金属质感，敲击声清越如金玉交鸣。
这令他感到舒畅无比，张口吐出一口气，便见吐纳间口鼻氤氲白雾，五脏六腑共鸣生霞，而这，赫然就是万化归玄炼体真经达到大成后带来的变化——金肌玉骨、内壮脏腑。
“御剑术！”
沈长青唤出飞剑，张开左掌，猛然御剑刺来。
他这一剑没有丝毫留手，用了全力。
叮！
刺目的火星溅射而起，飞剑发出剧烈的鸣颤，未能刺入分毫。
他收起飞剑，仔细一瞧，只能望见自己的手心里有一点淡淡的白痕，很显然，这能重伤人面雾鼍的一剑，连他的防御都无法破开！
这样的结果，沈长青十分满意，看着桌上木盒中还剩下的大半气血药，继续修炼。
对拥有天道酬勤天赋的他来说，修炼就是这样的，他只需努力炼化气血药就够了，而其他武者考虑的就多了……
又是数日的时间。
此刻，桌上的木盒早已空空如也，沈长青将最后一株赤血藤炼化。
当赤血藤化作最后一丝药力被吸收后，他恍然发觉自己全身都微微颤动了起来，啵的一声，好似有什么桎梏被打破。
他连忙内视己身，便注意到丹田气海内，原本气态的灵力开始浓缩，化作了一滴滴晶莹无比的液滴。
“这是，灵力化液？！”
这个变化足足持续了一刻的时间，直到身躯的颤动停止，沈长青这才惊觉，原本充盈无比的气海，此刻早已干涸一片，只在底部留下了薄薄的一层液态灵力。
一种消耗巨大的空虚感油然而生，他知道，这是灵力“亏空”才有的感觉。
没有迟疑，沈长青连忙取出灵石开始填补气海。
莫约一刻后，在他的面前便出现了一堆白色的粉末，这一次恢复，竟足足让他消耗了十枚灵石，要知道，先前在江家堡的时候，恢复灵力可是只用了不到半枚！
【功法：万化归玄炼体真经（圆满），太虚剑诀（未入门：200500），周天行气法（入门：3351000），养气术（圆满）】
“灵力储量至少增加了几十倍，而且灵力还变得更加精纯了，这就是万化归玄炼体真经圆满后的效果吗，真让人惊喜。”
伏妖卫为何普遍活不过一年？
因为在外城区以及城外那种地方，修士灵力有限，一旦消耗，危急情况下根本无法及时得到补充，而雾妖则不一样，它们可以通过吞噬黑雾恢复，此消彼长，久而久之，便是九死一生。
但现在，沈长青完全不用担心这一点了，因为他的灵力储量，浑厚无比！
此刻看着面板，他再次尝试施展了那一剑。
且慢。
content_en:
"Three bottles of boiling blood pills."
Among the qi and blood medicines given by Wu Qingya, there were only three bottles of boiling blood pills, to be precise, there were only three bottles of pills, and the rest were all kinds of rare treasures.
Each precious medicine is tied with a strip of cloth detailing its name and efficacy.
For example, Iron Bone Ginseng, which can strengthen muscles and bones, and Blood Jade Zhi, which can temper qi and blood, etc. Each of these qi and blood medicines is enough to make a group of stone castles fight for blood in the outer city, but there are several types here!
Perhaps because he felt that giving boiling blood pills was too "low-end", or because no one was using these qi and blood elixirs from the Demon Suppression Department, Wu Qingya gave a lot of them at once.
"It would be great if the cultivation resources could be given to me so generously."
Shen Changqing was stunned by Wu Qingya's handiwork. He swallowed and without wasting any time, he directly entered the selfless practice.
Time passes.
I don’t know how many days later.
In the courtyard room.
At a certain moment, Shen Changqing opened his eyes.
The skin all over his body exudes a faint golden luster, as if it is woven with countless golden glazed silks. The bone density of his whole body has increased dramatically. It not only contains the warm luster of white jade, but also has the texture of dark iron metal. The sound of knocking is as clear as the jingling of gold and jade.
This made him feel extremely comfortable. He opened his mouth and exhaled, and saw the white mist in his mouth and nose, and the internal organs resonated with clouds. This was clearly the change brought about after the Wanhua Guixuan Body Refining Sutra reached its climax - golden muscles and jade bones, and strong internal organs.
"Swordsmanship!"
Shen Changqing summoned the flying sword, opened his left palm, and suddenly stabbed with the sword.
He didn't hold back at all with this sword and used all his strength.
bite!
Dazzling sparks splashed up, and the flying sword trembled violently, failing to penetrate even a hair.
He put away the flying sword and took a closer look. He could only see a faint white mark on his palm. It was obvious that this sword, which could seriously injure a person, could not even break through his defense!
Shen Changqing was very satisfied with this result. He looked at most of the qi and blood medicine left in the wooden box on the table and continued to practice.
For him, who has the talent of being rewarded by heaven, cultivation is like this. He only needs to work hard to refine the qi and blood medicine, while other warriors have much more to consider...
A few more days passed.
At this moment, the wooden box on the table was already empty, and Shen Changqing refined the last red blood vine.
When the red blood vine turned into the last trace of medicinal power and was absorbed, he suddenly felt that his whole body was shaking slightly, and there was a pop sound, as if some shackles were broken.
He quickly looked inside himself and noticed that in the Dantian Qi Sea, the originally gaseous spiritual power began to condense and turned into droplets of extremely crystal clear liquid.
"This is spiritual power liquid?!"
This change lasted for a full moment, until the trembling of the body stopped, Shen Changqing was shocked to realize that the originally full sea of ​​qi had dried up, leaving only a thin layer of liquid spiritual power at the bottom.
A feeling of emptiness that consumed a huge amount of energy arose spontaneously. He knew that this was the feeling caused by a "deficit" in spiritual power.
Without hesitation, Shen Changqing quickly took out the spirit stone and began to fill the air sea.
About a moment later, a pile of white powder appeared in front of him. This recovery actually cost him ten spiritual stones. You know, when he was in Jiangjiabao, he only used less than half of them to restore his spiritual power!
[Exercise techniques: Wanhua Guixuan Body Refining Manual (Perfection), Taixu Sword Technique (Uninitiated: 200500), Zhoutian Qi Movement Technique (Entered: 3351000), Qi Nourishing Technique (Perfection)]
"The spiritual power reserve has increased at least dozens of times, and the spiritual power has become more pure. Is this the effect of the completion of the Wanhua Guixuan Body Refining Manual? It's really surprising."
Why do demon-subduing guards generally live less than a year?
Because in the outer city and places outside the city, the spiritual power of monks is limited. Once it is consumed, it cannot be replenished in time in critical situations. However, the mist demons are different. They can recover by swallowing the black mist.
But now, Shen Changqing doesn't have to worry about this at all, because his spiritual power reserves are extremely rich!
Looking at the panel now, he tried to use the sword again.
Wait.
